{

  "scripts": {
    "reset": "pnpx nx reset",
    "start": "pnpx nx serve erlebnis.stadt",

    "prepare": "pnpm run generate:api",
    "format": "nx format:write --all",
    "lint": "nx run-many -t lint",
    "test": "nx run-many -t test",
    "generate:feature-micro-experiences-api": "openapi-generator-cli generate --openapitools ./openapitools-feature-micro-experiences.json",

    "test:coverage": "nx run-many -t test --coverage --nxBail --skip-nx-cache --runInBand && pnpm run merge:coverage",
    "merge:coverage": "pnpx lcov-result-merger 'coverage/**/lcov.info' > coverage/merged-lcov.info",
    "build:all": "pnpm nx run-many -t build --prod && node ../scripts/verify-maplibre-assets.mjs app",
